description: This Java source file defines a utility helper class 'PoliciesJournalTestHelper' intended for testing Akka persistence journal with policies data. It provides methods to retrieve and process journal events related to policies, using in-memory read journal for testing purposes.

classes.name: PoliciesJournalTestHelper
classes.description: A final utility class providing methods to interact with the in-memory Akka persistence journal for testing policies-related events, converting journal entries into domain objects.

methods.name: PoliciesJournalTestHelper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the helper with an ActorSystem, a function to convert journal entries to domain objects, and a function to map PolicyId to persistence IDs. Sets up the in-memory read journal for querying.

methods.name: getAllEvents
methods.description: Retrieves all journal events associated with a specific PolicyId by querying the in-memory journal and converting each EventEnvelope into a domain object.

methods.name: getAllEventEnvelopes
methods.description: Fetches all event envelopes for the given persistence ID from the in-memory journal.

methods.name: convertEventEnvelopeToDomainObject
methods.description: Converts an EventEnvelope to a domain-specific object J by applying the provided journalEntryToDomainObject function.

methods.name: runBlockingWithReturn
methods.description: Executes an Akka Source publisher synchronously, awaiting results within a timeout, returning a list of items or throwing an exception on failure.
